Method of Attack: Exploits critical vulnerability CVE-2022-0543 in Redis to gain remote code execution
Abuses Redis replication feature to propagate malicious payloads and establish foothold
Downloads OS-specific scripts and binaries to infected servers
Modifies SSH configuration to enable password authentication and adds attacker SSH keys
Renames wget and curl binaries to hinder incident response and EDR detection
Installs missing utilities (iptables, awk, netstat) to manage network rules and monitor connections
Adds iptables rules to restrict Redis server access and allow botnet communication
Establishes persistence and upgrades malware binaries
Forms a peer-to-peer botnet network for command propagation without centralized C2
Scans random /16 network prefixes for exposed SSH and Redis servers using brute-force password attempts
Attack Vector: Exposed Redis instances vulnerable to CVE-2022-0543
Exposed Redis replication feature allowing malicious replication
Exposed SSH servers with weak or brute-forced credentials
